args.title: Add option to disable BOM prefix in CSV export
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The default behavior prefixes a byte order mark (BOM) to CSV exports to aid UTF-8 detection in spreadsheet apps. The proposed change is to respect the boolean 'bom' option in CsvOptions passed to writeCsv, allowing disabling this prefix when set to false.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/export/csv.ts is chosen because it implements the CSV export and includes the option to prefix a byte order mark (BOM) by default. The feature request is to allow disabling this BOM prefix by using the 'bom' option in CsvOptions when calling writeCsv.
